title: Allows the two layers of headers to be correctly aligned
goal: uses rowspan and colspan to organize group headers.
summary: The venue heading spans two rows. The two weekend dates share a group heading.
tasks: Make "Venue" span two lines down and write scope="col" for it.
Make "Saturday and Sunday" span both columns.
removes the empty th in the second row, leaving "Saturday" "Sunday" two column headers.

example.note: The position occupied by rowspan is automatically reserved in the next line without inserting additional spaces.

hint: The row of rowspan is the row, and the col of colspan is the column.
